name: AXM Spatial Studio
summary: One local-first spatial workspace for 3D scenes, parametric geometry, material recipes, hierarchy, animation, bounded simulation proofs, WebGL previews, voxels, templates and explicit delivery.
notes: Real local features are distinguished from adapter slots. Validated editable Spatial projects and material graphs can enter through the shared Asset Hands registry with complete canvas and creation provenance. Full 3D dynamics, sculpting, UV baking, skin deformation, fluids, cloth, hair, volumes, path tracing and photogrammetry remain unavailable until executable adapters return evidence. Nothing publishes automatically.
